## Goal
- Build and serve an IVX-branded Android APK from the Expo/React Native project, then upgrade the investment card with full old-card investment details, timeline stages, and deploy end-to-end.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **Expo/React Native is the ACTIVE production app** — Kotlin `android-ivx-holdings/` is abandoned per owner instruction
- Owner explicitly said "stop kotlin freeze that" — no Kotlin work
- Use `bun` not `npx`/`npm` in this environment
- No fabricated proof — every VERIFIED claim must have real evidence
- No business data modification during QA
- Investment card upgrade: KEEP new card visual design, DO NOT revert to old layout; COPY all old-card investment details into new card; ADD timeline; preserve View Deal, Invest Now, categories, actions, image carousel, status badges
- Never show `null`, `undefined`, `NaN`, or empty spaces in UI — use "Not available" or "Timeline pending verification" fallbacks
- Canonical push path is `expo/sync-github.mjs` using Git Data API
- Rork git proxy does NOT forward to GitHub

## Progress
### Done
- **APK BUILD #7 COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY** — `expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk` — 79MB compressed, 104MB uncompressed, BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 45s
- **APK fully audited** — all 4 CPU architectures present (58 .so files: arm64-v8a:16, armeabi-v7a:14, x86:14, x86_64:14), 242 screens, 67 components, 177 lib files, 120 src modules, 55 npm deps, 27 Expo modules, 14MB JS bundle, 4 DEX files (32.5MB), react-native-maps linked, expo-location correctly excluded (0 references)
- **APK served via Cloudflare tunnel** — `https://designated-mississippi-devel-screen.trycloudflare.com/ivx-holdings-v1.4.5.apk` (verified HTTP 200, content-length 82475844)
- **Build fixes applied:**
  - Copied `assets/images/splash-icon.png` → `android/app/src/main/res/drawable/splashscreen_logo.png`
  - Created mipmap dirs (hdpi/mdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi) with `ic_launcher_foreground.png` (from adaptive-icon.png), `ic_launcher.png` and `ic_launcher_round.png` (from icon.png)
  - Correct JAVA_HOME: `/usr/lib/jvm/jdk-17.0.13+11` (not `/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-17-jdk`)
- **Investment Card Upgrade — code written:**
  - Created `expo/lib/timeline-stages.ts` — TimelineStage/TimelineSummary types, buildTimelineSummary(), getTimelineStatusColor(), formatTimelineDate(), 7 canonical stages
  - Rewrote `expo/components/InvestmentCard.tsx` — extended InvestmentCardData with salePrice, totalInvestment, timelineMin/Max/Unit, minimumOwnershipPercent, fractionalStartAmount, developerName, developerLogo, investmentDetails, timelineSummary; added investment summary panel, timeline summary with progress bar, min investment/ownership row, developer row, collapsible details with full timeline stages
  - Updated `expo/components/InvestorFirstFeed.tsx` — rewrote homeFeedDealToInvestmentCard() to map all investment fields from deal identity + trust market
  - Updated `expo/app/jv-invest.tsx` — added investment summary panel, timeline summary box, developer row, expandable timeline stages section with all styles
  - Updated `expo/lib/published-deal-card-model.ts` — added timelineSummary to interface, buildTimelineSummary call, landing HTML generator with timeline box, canonical JSON with timeline fields
  - Created `expo/__tests__/investment-card-timeline.test.ts` — tests for timeline stages, field mapping, empty/invalid data, card/detail parity
- **Previous QA run `qa-b400e2f1` COMPLETED with VERIFIED status** — 1232 tests pass
- **`expo/` node_modules installed** — 1339 packages
- **Watchman bypass working** — fake watchman at `/tmp/fakebin/watchman` + `metro.config.js` patched with `useWatchman = false`
- **boto3 installed** via pip3 for potential S3 uploads
- **Created `expo/scripts/upload-apk.mjs`** — raw S3 upload using AWS Signature v4

### In Progress
- **Investment Card Upgrade — validation & deployment phase** — code is written but lint, typecheck, tests, and build have NOT been run yet
- **Landing page sync** — HTML generator updated in `published-deal-card-model.ts` but not deployed

### Blocked
- **AWS credentials NOT in environment** — confirmed missing via env, printenv, /proc/self/environ, node, bun, python3; requestEnvs said "already_set" but vars are empty; forced request returned "awaiting_user_input" then user confirmed set but still empty; cannot upload to S3 (`ivxholding.com` bucket)

## Key Decisions
- Built APK with all 4 architectures (not arm64-only) — `gradle.properties` has `reactNativeArchitectures=armeabi-v7a,arm64-v8a,x86,x86_64`
- 79MB compressed vs 104MB uncompressed is normal R8 code shrinking + debug symbol stripping — no content lost
- Used Cloudflare tunnel (cloudflared from node_modules) to serve APK directly from sandbox as workaround for missing AWS creds
- Investment card: kept new compact design, added investment summary panel with 4 metrics (sale price, total investment, ROI, timeline), timeline summary with progress bar, min investment/ownership row, developer row, collapsible details with full 7-stage timeline
- Timeline stages auto-generated from timelineMin/timelineMax when no explicit stages provided; fall back to "Timeline pending verification" when no timeline data

## Next Steps
- Run lint, typecheck, and unit tests for the investment card upgrade
- Build new APK with updated card
- QA production deals (Jacksonville Prime, Casa Rosario, One Stop Development/Perez Residence, Casa Rosario Reel)
- Sync landing page with new card design
- Commit and push via `expo/sync-github.mjs`
- Deploy backend if data contract changed
- Deploy landing page
- Produce mandatory final report per owner's spec
- Resolve AWS credential issue for permanent S3 upload to `ivxholding.com/apk/`

## Critical Context
- Expo app: `com.ivxholdings.app`, version `1.4.5`, versionCode `36`, SDK 54
- Android build: compileSdk 36, minSdk 24, targetSdk 36, NDK 27.1.12297006, Kotlin 2.1.20
- JAVA_HOME: `/usr/lib/jvm/jdk-17.0.13+11` (NOT `/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-17-jdk`)
- Gradle 8.14.3, ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk
- Build command: `cd expo/android && JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/jdk-17.0.13+11 ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk PATH="/tmp/fakebin:$JAVA_HOME/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH" ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease --no-daemon --build-cache`
- Backend URL: `https://api.ivxholding.com` (healthy, verified)
- Landing URL: `https://ivxholding.com`
- S3 bucket: `ivxholding.com`, CloudFront: `E1C0DEI0VKCUYN`
- Cloudflare tunnel APK download: `https://designated-mississippi-devel-screen.trycloudflare.com/ivx-holdings-v1.4.5.apk` (temporary)
- APK SHA256: `d1e8a49d9f313ece90ca91f1c332fe4797eadcca523165f74c37309b19ef4863`
- 7 canonical timeline stages: Acquisition/Closing, Permits/Design, Construction Start, Structural/Rough Work, Interior Finishes, Final Inspection, Sale/Refinance/Distribution
- Timeline statuses: UPCOMING, ACTIVE, DELAYED, COMPLETE

## Relevant Files
- `expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk` — built APK (79MB)
- `expo/components/InvestmentCard.tsx` — REWRITTEN — canonical compact investment card with all investment details + timeline
- `expo/components/InvestorFirstFeed.tsx` — UPDATED — homeFeedDealToInvestmentCard() maps all investment fields
- `expo/lib/timeline-stages.ts` — NEW — TimelineStage/TimelineSummary types, buildTimelineSummary(), 7 canonical stages
- `expo/app/jv-invest.tsx` — UPDATED — deal detail screen with investment summary panel, timeline, developer row, expandable stages
- `expo/lib/published-deal-card-model.ts` — UPDATED — timelineSummary in model, landing HTML generator with timeline, canonical JSON with timeline fields
- `expo/__tests__/investment-card-timeline.test.ts` — NEW — tests for timeline, field mapping, parity
- `expo/scripts/upload-apk.mjs` — NEW — raw S3 upload script using AWS Sig v4
- `expo/android/gradle.properties` — `reactNativeArchitectures=armeabi-v7a,arm64-v8a,x86,x86_64`, `hermesEnabled=true`
- `expo/metro.config.js` — patched with `config.watcher.useWatchman = false`
- `expo/app.config.ts` — Expo config, version 1.4.5, `com.ivxholdings.app`
- `/tmp/fakebin/watchman` — fake watchman binary
- `expo/sync-github.mjs` — Git Data API push script
- `expo/scripts/deploy-landing.mjs` — S3 upload + CloudFront invalidation pattern
